Overview.Name: Srinivas Gandla
Overview.Food_Habit: I lose control if I start eating
Overview.Goal: Managing diabetes and thyroid-related issues, Preventing/reversing health issues, Improving energy levels and maintaining healthy body composition
Overview.Preference_Notes: Results first – include non-veg as needed, avoids non-veg on Monday, Saturday and Sunday

Meal_1: Option 1: Fish curry (120 g fish) + cooked rice (150 g)
Option 2: Egg omelette (2–3 eggs) + cucumber slices
Option 3: Paneer pan fried (120 g) + curd
Meal_2 (Main Lunch Meal): Option 1: Fish curry (150 g fish) + cooked rice (150 g) + vegetable curry
Option 2: Chicken curry (120 g) + cooked rice (150 g)
Option 3: Paneer curry (120 g) + cooked rice (150 g) + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Follow vegetarian options on Monday, Saturday and Sunday.
Avoid sweets, fruit juices and sugary drinks to support diabetes management.
Maintain fixed meal timings as much as possible despite business hours.
Avoid eating very late at night and keep dinner lighter.
Get at least 30 minutes of morning sunlight daily to support thyroid health and energy levels.
Take a 10–15 minute walk after major meals to help blood sugar control.
Regular sleep timing and consistent meals will improve both thyroid and diabetes management.
